title: 全部生词图片复习（1/2）｜25词
summary: 中文情境提问，三秒回忆；英德答案与美式音标；英语例句以零点八倍两遍、零点九倍一遍，中文一遍，配简洁记忆图。

words.question: 表格里要求填写职位的正式名称，表示名称、称谓的英语名词是什么？
words.example: Please enter your job designation on the form.
words.translation: 请在表格上填写你的职位名称。
words.image_prompt: A person filling a simple office form with a blank name badge beside it, focus on assigning an official title.

words.question: 从数据库里把需要的文件调出来，英语动词是什么？
words.example: You can retrieve the file from the database.
words.translation: 你可以从数据库中调取这个文件。
words.image_prompt: One large folder emerging from a simple database cylinder into a person's hand, clear retrieval action.

words.question: 不扔掉旧文件，而是把它保存下来，表示保留的英语动词是什么？
words.example: Please retain a copy of the receipt.
words.translation: 请保留一份收据副本。
words.image_prompt: A hand placing a receipt safely into a small archive folder instead of a nearby wastebasket.

words.question: 把几个来源的资料收集起来整理成清单，英语动词是什么？
words.example: She compiled a list of useful sources.
words.translation: 她整理了一份有用的资料来源清单。
words.image_prompt: Three separate paper sheets being brought together into one tidy clipboard list by two hands.

words.question: 除了主要材料，还有一份补充材料。表示补充的、附加的英语形容词是什么？
words.example: The supplementary material includes two diagrams.
words.translation: 补充材料包含两张示意图。
words.image_prompt: A main thick report booklet beside a smaller additional sheet containing two simple diagrams, large plus sign between them.

words.question: 几个部分共同构成一个整体，表示构成的英语动词是什么？
words.example: These three parts constitute the whole device.
words.translation: 这三个部件构成了整台设备。
words.image_prompt: Three simple colored mechanical parts fitting together to make one complete compact device, no complex engineering details.

words.question: 从整体来看，它包含哪些组成部分。表示包含、由什么组成的英语动词是什么？
words.example: The kit comprises a camera and two lenses.
words.translation: 这套器材包含一台相机和两个镜头。
words.image_prompt: An open camera kit case neatly containing exactly one camera and two lenses.

words.question: 这套软件是公司内部自己开发的。表示内部的、在内部的英语表达是什么？
words.example: We developed the software in-house.
words.translation: 这套软件由我们内部开发。
words.image_prompt: Two colleagues coding together inside a simple office outline, all work clearly contained within the same building.

words.question: 满足申请条件，有资格获得这项资助，英语形容词是什么？
words.example: You may be eligible for a travel grant.
words.translation: 你可能符合申请旅行补助的条件。
words.image_prompt: A student showing a train ticket and an application checklist with all boxes checked, administrator gives a green approval check.

words.question: 团队准备实施一项安全测试。表示开展、执行的英语短语是什么？
words.example: The team will carry out a safety test.
words.translation: 团队将开展一项安全测试。
words.image_prompt: An engineer actually testing a small machine using a handheld meter, a simple checklist nearby.

words.question: 按照一份检查清单审核方案，表示依据某标准审核的英语表达是什么？
words.example: We reviewed the plan against the checklist.
words.translation: 我们依据检查清单审核了这份方案。
words.image_prompt: Two hands comparing a simple plan sheet and a separate checklist side by side, matching rows with checkmarks.

words.question: 收到反馈后修改报告，表示修订的英语动词是什么？
words.example: I need to revise the report before Friday.
words.translation: 我需要在周五之前修改报告。
words.image_prompt: A person erasing and replacing a marked line on a report page with a pencil, visible correction marks without text.

words.question: 方案符合学校的要求，表示符合、与什么一致的英语表达是什么？
words.example: The plan is in line with university guidelines.
words.translation: 这个方案符合学校的指导要求。
words.image_prompt: A simple plan sheet and a university guideline sheet aligned side by side with matching shapes and one approval check.

words.question: 第一次测试之后又进行了一次测试，表示随后的英语形容词是什么？
words.example: The subsequent test confirmed the result.
words.translation: 随后的测试证实了这个结果。
words.image_prompt: Two simple laboratory test setups arranged along a short left-to-right arrow, second test has a confirmation check.

words.question: 一个决定可能带来什么影响或后果，表示这种影响的英语名词是什么？
words.example: We discussed the implications of the delay.
words.translation: 我们讨论了延期可能带来的影响。
words.image_prompt: A delayed clock leading by an arrow to a shifted calendar appointment and a worried person, simple cause-and-consequence composition.

words.question: 几个部分组成一个整体，表示组成的英语动词是什么？
words.example: The report is composed of several short sections.
words.translation: 这份报告由几个简短的章节组成。
words.image_prompt: Several short paper sections being assembled into a single bound report, hands align the pieces.

words.question: 正式调查前先做初步核查，表示初步的、预备的英语形容词是什么？
words.example: The preliminary results look promising.
words.translation: 初步结果看起来很有希望。
words.image_prompt: A scientist examining a first small set of results on a clipboard before a larger unfinished experiment in the background.

words.question: 从系统里取回资料这个过程，表示检索、调取的英语名词是什么？
words.example: The new system makes data retrieval faster.
words.translation: 新系统让数据检索更快。
words.image_prompt: A simple database cylinder connected to an open folder by a short arrow with a small stopwatch, quick retrieval.

words.question: 正式结果还没出来，先给一个临时安排。表示暂定的、临时的英语形容词是什么？
words.example: We received provisional approval for the project.
words.translation: 我们的项目获得了临时批准。
words.image_prompt: An administrator places a removable checkmark sticky note on a project folder, final approval seal still blank nearby.

words.question: 报告经过修改后有了新版本，表示修订、修改的英语名词是什么？
words.example: This revision makes the instructions clearer.
words.translation: 这次修订让说明更清楚了。
words.image_prompt: A confusing instruction page on the left transforms into a neat simple instruction page on the right, visible crossed-out lines and cleaner icons.

words.zh: 边界上的；难以明确归类的
words.question: 一个样本正好在两个类别的边界，难以明确归类。表示边界上的英语形容词是什么？
words.example: This is a borderline case between the two categories.
words.translation: 这是处于两个类别之间的边界案例。
words.image_prompt: A single two-colored block sitting exactly on the dividing line between two differently colored sorting trays.

words.question: 在文件里清楚列出规则或要求，表示阐述、列出的英语短语是什么？
words.example: The document sets out the safety requirements.
words.translation: 这份文件列明了安全要求。
words.image_prompt: A hand laying out three clear safety pictograms in an orderly row on a single document.

words.question: 把文件按统一方法分类，表示方案、分类体系的英语名词是什么？
words.example: We use a simple scheme to classify the files.
words.translation: 我们用一套简单的方法给文件分类。
words.image_prompt: Three color-coded file folders neatly sorted into three matching labeled-with-shapes compartments, no words.

words.question: 椅子绕着底下的轴转向另一边，表示绕轴转动的英语动词是什么？
words.example: She swivelled her chair to face the window.
words.translation: 她转动椅子，面向窗户。
words.image_prompt: A person in an office swivel chair turning toward a window, short curved arrow around the central chair stem.

words.question: 零件沿直线移动，不发生转动。表示平移的英语形容词是什么？
words.example: The guide allows only translational motion.
words.translation: 这个导轨只允许平移运动。
words.image_prompt: A simple square carriage on one straight horizontal rail, straight arrow along the rail, no rotation arrow or complex machinery.
